rows.question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH dept_dlc AS (
  SELECT
    `DLC_KEY`,
    `DLC_NAME`
  FROM master_dept_hierarchy
  WHERE LOWER(`DLC_NAME`) = LOWER('History')
),
latest_dept AS (
  SELECT
    d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    d.`DLC_KEY`,
    d.`DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE`
  FROM sis_department d
  JOIN dept_dlc m ON d.`DLC_KEY` = m.`DLC_KEY`
  -- keep as-is; if multiple rows, choose latest activity date
  ORDER BY d.`DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE` DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
org_for_dept AS (
  -- join to fclt_organization (and history table) via DLC_KEY or HR_DEPT_CODE_OLD as available
  SELECT fo.`FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
         fo.`ORGANIZATION`,
         fo.`DLC_KEY`,
         fo.`HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
         fo.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD`
  FROM fclt_organization fo
  JOIN latest_dept ld
    ON (fo.`DLC_KEY` = ld.`DLC_KEY` OR fo.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD` = ld.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`)
  LIMIT 1
),
building_for_org AS (
  -- link organization -> fclt_organization_hist -> fclt_building (by HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD maybe in hist)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    bhf.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`,
    bhf.`BUILDING_NUMBER`
  FROM fclt_organization_hist oh
  JOIN org_for_dept od
    ON (oh.`DLC_KEY` = od.`DLC_KEY` OR oh.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD` = od.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD` OR oh.`HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME` = od.`HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME`)
  JOIN fclt_building bhf
    ON (bhf.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = oh.`HR_ORG_UNIT_ID` OR bhf.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = oh.`ORGANIZATION_NUMBER` OR bhf.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = NULLIF(oh.`ORGANIZATION_NUMBER`, ''))
  -- if no reliable numeric join, also attempt to join by DLC_KEY through building address tables later
  LIMIT 1
),
street_address AS (
  -- prefer fclt_building_address then fac_building_address
  SELECT
    fb.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      NULLIF(fb.`STREET_NUMBER`,''), NULLIF(fb.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL`,''), NULLIF(fb.`STREET_NAME`,''), NULLIF(fb.`STREET_SUFFIX`,''), NULLIF(fb.`POST_DIRECTIONAL`,'')) AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    fb.`CITY`,
    fb.`STATE`,
    fb.`POSTAL_CODE`
  FROM fclt_building_address fb
  JOIN building_for_org bfo ON fb.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` = bfo.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`
  WHERE fb.`ADDRESS_PURPOSE` = 'STREET'
  UNION
  SELECT
    fbb.`BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      NULLIF(fbb.`STREET_NUMBER`,''), NULLIF(fbb.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL`,''), NULLIF(fbb.`STREET_NAME`,''), NULLIF(fbb.`STREET_SUFFIX`,''), NULLIF(fbb.`POST_DIRECTIONAL`,'')) AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    fbb.`CITY`,
    fbb.`STATE`,
    fbb.`POSTAL_CODE`
  FROM fac_building_address fbb
  JOIN building_for_org bfo ON fbb.`BUILDING_KEY` = bfo.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`
  WHERE fbb.`ADDRESS_PURPOSE` = 'STREET'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  sa.BUILDING_KEY AS current_building_key,
  sa.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS building_street_address,
  sa.CITY AS city,
  sa.STATE AS state,
  sa.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code
FROM street_address sa
LIMIT 1

rows.question: What is the room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of Professor Summer Haynes's office?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  er.OFFICE_LOCATION AS building_key,
  fr.ROOM AS room,
  fr.FLOOR AS floor,
  CONCAT(
    COALESCE(ba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''), 
    CASE WHEN ba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND ba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(ba.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
    COALESCE(ba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX, ''),
    CASE WHEN (ba.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND ba.STREET_NUMBER <> '') AND (ba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ba.STREET_NAME <> '') THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(ba.STREET_NAME, ''),
    CASE WHEN ba.STREET_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND ba.STREET_SUFFIX <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(ba.STREET_SUFFIX, ''),
    CASE WHEN ba.POST_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND ba.POST_DIRECTIONAL <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(ba.POST_DIRECTIONAL, '')
  ) AS building_street_address,
  ba.CITY AS building_city,
  ba.STATE AS building_state,
  ba.POSTAL_CODE AS building_postal_code
FROM employee_directory AS er
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms AS fr
  ON er.OFFICE_LOCATION = fr.SPACE_ID
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address AS ba
  ON ba.BUILDING_KEY = er.OFFICE_LOCATION
WHERE er.FULL_NAME = 'Haynes, Summer'
  AND ba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
ORDER BY er.OFFICE_LOCATION, fr.FLOOR, fr.ROOM

rows.question: List the unique full room names, their corresponding building names, street addresses, cities, states, postal codes, and building heights for rooms associated with subjects that Computer Science students can enroll in.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH cs_offered AS (
  -- subjects offered by the Electrical Eng & Computer Sci department
  SELECT DISTINCT
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  FROM subject_offered so
  JOIN sis_department sd
    ON so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
    AND (so.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL OR so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL)
),
rooms_for_cs AS (
  -- rooms from two room tables that are associated with the department/subject
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY AS ROOM_KEY,
    fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY
  FROM fclt_rooms fr
  JOIN cs_offered co
    ON co.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = fr.DEPT_CODE OR co.SUBJECT_ID = fr.DEPT_CODE

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT
    fr2.FAC_ROOM_KEY AS ROOM_KEY,
    fr2.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    fr2.BUILDING_KEY
  FROM fac_rooms fr2
  JOIN cs_offered co2
    ON co2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = fr2.DEPT_CODE OR co2.SUBJECT_ID = fr2.DEPT_CODE
),
building_addresses AS (
  -- only STREET addresses
  SELECT
    fba.BUILDING_KEY,
    fba.STREET_NUMBER,
    fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
    fba.STREET_NAME,
    fba.STREET_SUFFIX,
    fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL,
    fba.CITY,
    fba.STATE,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE
  FROM fac_building_address fba
  WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
),
buildings AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT
  FROM fac_building fb
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  -- compose a street address from components, skipping NULLs
  CONCAT_WS(' ',
    ba.STREET_NUMBER,
    ba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
    ba.STREET_NAME,
    ba.STREET_SUFFIX,
    ba.POST_DIRECTIONAL
  ) AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  ba.CITY,
  ba.STATE,
  ba.POSTAL_CODE,
  b.BUILDING_HEIGHT
FROM rooms_for_cs r
LEFT JOIN buildings b
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN building_addresses ba
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = ba.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE r.ROOM_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NAME, r.ROOM_FULL_NAME

rows.question: List the unique term code, subject title, room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code, formats, and number of enrolled students for all courses with more than 300 attendees.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH enrolled_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    so.`TERM_CODE` AS term_code,
    so.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS subject_title,
    so.`MEET_PLACE` AS meet_place,
    so.`MEET_TIME` AS meet_time,
    so.`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS` AS num_enrolled_students,
    so.`SECTION_ID` AS section_id,
    so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS faculty_id,
    so.`CLUSTER_TYPE` AS format -- use CLUSTER_TYPE as a proxy for format/delivery where available
  FROM subject_offered so
  WHERE COALESCE(so.`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`,0) > 300
),
room_mapping AS (
  -- attempt to parse building number from MEET_PLACE (common formats like "BUILDING-ROOM" or "BUILDING ROOM")
  SELECT
    es.*,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(es.meet_place, '-', 1)) AS maybe_building_number_dash,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(es.meet_place, ' ', 1)) AS maybe_building_number_space,
    es.meet_place AS meet_place_raw
  FROM enrolled_subjects es
),
building_lookup AS (
  -- try to resolve building by BUILDING_NUMBER to buildings table
  SELECT
    rm.*,
    b.`BUILDING_KEY` AS building_key,
    b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS building_number,
    b.`BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS` AS building_street_address,
    b.`BUILDING_NAME` AS building_name,
    b.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS b_warehouse_load_date
  FROM room_mapping rm
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = rm.maybe_building_number_dash
       OR b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = rm.maybe_building_number_space
),
address_sel AS (
  -- collect STREET addresses from both fac_building_address and fclt_building_address
  SELECT
    fba.`BUILDING_KEY` AS building_key,
    fba.`CITY` AS city,
    fba.`STATE` AS state,
    fba.`POSTAL_CODE` AS postal_code,
    TRIM(CONCAT(
      COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`STREET_NUMBER`,''),''),
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`STREET_NUMBER`,''),'') <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL`,''),''),
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL`,''),'') <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`STREET_NAME`,''),''),
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`STREET_SUFFIX`,''),'') <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`STREET_SUFFIX`,''),'')
    )) AS formatted_street_address,
    fba.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS addr_warehouse_load_date
  FROM fac_building_address fba
  WHERE fba.`ADDRESS_PURPOSE` = 'STREET'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    f.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` AS building_key,
    f.`CITY` AS city,
    f.`STATE` AS state,
    f.`POSTAL_CODE` AS postal_code,
    TRIM(CONCAT(
      COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`STREET_NUMBER`,''),''),
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`STREET_NUMBER`,''),'') <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL`,''),''),
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL`,''),'') <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`STREET_NAME`,''),''),
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`STREET_SUFFIX`,''),'') <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`STREET_SUFFIX`,''),'')
    )) AS formatted_street_address,
    f.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS addr_warehouse_load_date
  FROM fclt_building_address f
  WHERE f.`ADDRESS_PURPOSE` = 'STREET'
),
latest_address AS (
  -- pick most recent address per building_key
  SELECT
    a.building_key,
    a.city,
    a.state,
    a.postal_code,
    a.formatted_street_address,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.building_key ORDER BY a.addr_warehouse_load_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM address_sel a
),
final_addresses AS (
  SELECT building_key, city, state, postal_code, formatted_street_address
  FROM latest_address
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  bl.term_code AS term_code,
  bl.subject_title AS subject_title,
  bl.meet_place_raw AS room,
  zr.`FLOOR` AS floor,
  bl.building_key AS building_key,
  COALESCE(fa.formatted_street_address, bl.building_street_address) AS building_street_address,
  fa.city AS city,
  fa.state AS state,
  fa.postal_code AS postal_code,
  -- provide formats: prefer explicit format field, fallback to MEET_TIME as a descriptive surrogate
  COALESCE(NULLIF(bl.format,''), NULLIF(bl.meet_time,'')) AS formats,
  bl.num_enrolled_students AS num_enrolled_students
FROM building_lookup bl
LEFT JOIN final_addresses fa
  ON fa.building_key = bl.building_key
LEFT JOIN zpm_rooms_load zr
  ON zr.`BUILDING_ROOM` = bl.meet_place_raw
     OR zr.`BUILDING_ROOM` = TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(bl.meet_place_raw, '-', -1))
     OR zr.`SPACE_UNIT_CODE` = bl.meet_place_raw
WHERE bl.num_enrolled_students > 300

rows.question: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, and total costs of new materials for each subject title?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  tm.TITLE AS material_title,
  NULLIF(tm.ISBN, '') AS isbn,
  SUM(COALESCE(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, 0)) AS total_new_material_cost
FROM subject_offered so
JOIN tip_detail td
  ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
  AND td.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN tip_material tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
-- Only include materials that are marked as new.
-- The schema doesn't have an explicit "status = new" column on tip_material,
-- but tip_detail has TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY which can indicate status.
-- Join to tip_material_status if present and filter by a code or name that denotes "new".
LEFT JOIN tip_material_status tms
  ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
WHERE
  -- require a subject title and material title
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
  AND tm.TITLE IS NOT NULL
  -- include only materials whose status indicates "new"
  AND (
    -- match common ways "new" might be represented
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE = 'NEW'
    OR LOWER(tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS) = 'new'
    OR tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE IS NULL AND LOWER(tm.TITLE) LIKE '%new%' -- fallback heuristic
  )
GROUP BY
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  tm.TITLE,
  tm.ISBN
ORDER BY
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  tm.TITLE

rows.question: For each sponsor of the independent activity periods, list the sponsor name, number of sessions held, the total number of enrollment, the minimum and maximum fee, the number of sessions with info, and the number of sessions without info.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH sessions_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS session_id,
    sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY AS sponsor_id,
    sp.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
    -- MAX_ENROLLMENT is int per schema; keep NULLs as NULL
    d.MAX_ENROLLMENT AS enrollment_num,
    -- FEE is int per schema
    d.FEE AS fee_num,
    CASE
      WHEN s.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'Y' THEN 'Y'
      WHEN s.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'N' THEN 'N'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS has_session_info_flag
  FROM iap_subject_session s
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail d
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_sponsor sp
    ON sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  -- Only include sessions that are part of Independent Activities Period (IAP).
  -- There is no explicit column named to indicate IAP in schema; assume sessions in iap_subject_session are IAP sessions.
  -- (If a TERM_CODE or other flag were required, additional filter would be added here.)
)
SELECT
  sponsor_name AS SPONSOR,
  COUNT(session_id) AS NUM_SESSIONS,
  SUM(enrollment_num) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  MIN(fee_num) AS MIN_FEE,
  MAX(fee_num) AS MAX_FEE,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_session_info_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SESSIONS_WITH_INFO,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_session_info_flag = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SESSIONS_WITHOUT_INFO
FROM sessions_normalized
GROUP BY sponsor_id, sponsor_name
ORDER BY NUM_SESSIONS DESC

rows.question: What are the individual's email and name, academic year, total number of IAP subjects, the minimum and maximum fees, and the total course enrollment for each individual and academic year?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_details AS (
  SELECT
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
    p.PERSON_EMAIL,
    p.PERSON_NAME,
    d.TERM_CODE,
    -- Keep FEE as NULL when absent so MIN/MAX can be NULL when no IAP subjects for a person-term
    d.FEE,
    -- Use MAX_ENROLLMENT as the enrollment value per subject (could be NULL)
    d.MAX_ENROLLMENT
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_person p
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
),
-- Aggregate per person and term for IAP subjects (rows in iap_subject_detail are IAP subjects)
agg_per_person_term AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
    PERSON_EMAIL,
    PERSON_NAME,
    TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_IAP_SUBJECTS,
    MIN(FEE) AS MIN_FEE,
    MAX(FEE) AS MAX_FEE,
    SUM(COALESCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT,0)) AS TOTAL_COURSE_ENROLLMENT
  FROM subject_details
  GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY, PERSON_EMAIL, PERSON_NAME, TERM_CODE
)
SELECT
  IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
  PERSON_EMAIL,
  PERSON_NAME,
  TERM_CODE AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  TOTAL_IAP_SUBJECTS AS TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_IAP_SUBJECTS,
  MIN_FEE AS MINIMUM_FEE,
  MAX_FEE AS MAXIMUM_FEE,

WITH

  SELECT
    fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS building_name,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT,

  FROM fclt_building fb

    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

building_keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key FROM fclt_building WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key FROM fclt_rooms WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT BUILDING_KEY AS building_key FROM fac_floor WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT BUILDING_KEY AS building_key FROM fac_building WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
building_to_dlc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    bk.building_key,
    COALESCE(fo.DLC_KEY, su.DLC_KEY, foh.DLC_KEY, pod.DLC_KEY) AS dlc_key
  FROM building_keys bk
  LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fr ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bk.building_key
  LEFT JOIN fclt_organization fo ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN space_unit su ON su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY OR su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fclt_organization_hist foh ON foh.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fclt_org_dlc_key pod ON pod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
),
dlc_details AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    md.DLC_KEY,
    md.DLC_NAME
  FROM master_dept_hierarchy md
  WHERE md.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    pg.DLC_KEY,
    pg.DLC_NAME
  FROM profit_center_group pg
  WHERE pg.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fo.DLC_KEY,
    fo.DLC_NAME
  FROM fclt_organization fo
  WHERE fo.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
building_floors AS (
  SELECT
    bf.building_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bf.floor) AS floor_count
  FROM (
    SELECT BUILDING_KEY AS building_key, FLOOR AS floor FROM fac_floor WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key, FLOOR AS floor FROM fclt_floor WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key, FLOOR AS floor FROM fclt_rooms WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  ) bf
  GROUP BY bf.building_key
),
building_orgs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS org_key,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fo.DLC_KEY
  FROM fclt_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN fclt_organization fo ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
org_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT
    child.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS child_org_key,
    child.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS child_org_name,
    parent.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS parent_org_key,
    parent.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS parent_org_name,
    child.DLC_KEY
  FROM fclt_organization child
  LEFT JOIN fclt_organization parent
    ON child.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY = parent.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
),
building_supervisors AS (
  SELECT
    bk.building_key,
    btd.dlc_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oh.parent_org_key IS NOT NULL THEN oh.parent_org_key END) AS total_supervisors,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oh.child_org_key IS NOT NULL THEN oh.child_org_key END) AS total_supervisees
  FROM building_keys bk
  LEFT JOIN building_to_dlc btd ON btd.building_key = bk.building_key
  LEFT JOIN building_orgs bo ON bo.building_key = bk.building_key AND (btd.dlc_key IS NULL OR bo.DLC_KEY = btd.dlc_key)
  LEFT JOIN org_hierarchy oh ON oh.DLC_KEY = COALESCE(btd.dlc_key, bo.DLC_KEY)
    AND (oh.parent_org_key = bo.org_key OR oh.child_org_key = bo.org_key)
  GROUP BY bk.building_key, btd.dlc_key
),
building_org_counts AS (
  SELECT
    boc.building_key,
    COALESCE(boc.DLC_KEY, (SELECT btd.dlc_key FROM building_to_dlc btd WHERE btd.building_key = boc.building_key LIMIT 1)) AS dlc_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT boc.org_key) AS org_count
  FROM building_orgs boc
  GROUP BY boc.building_key, COALESCE(boc.DLC_KEY, (SELECT btd.dlc_key FROM building_to_dlc btd WHERE btd.building_key = boc.building_key LIMIT 1))
),
building_totals AS (
  SELECT
    bk.building_key,
    bb.building_name,
    bb.building_number,
    COALESCE(bf.floor_count, 0) AS total_floors,
    COALESCE(bb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, bb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, 0) AS total_square_footage,
    COALESCE(boc.org_count, 0) AS total_facility_organizations,
    COALESCE(bs.total_supervisors, 0) AS total_supervisors,

    SUM(

        WHEN bb.BUILDING_HEIGHT REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(bb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS DECIMAL(18,4))
        WHEN bb.BUILDING_HEIGHT REGEXP '^[0-9]+\\s*ft' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(bb.BUILDING_HEIGHT,' ',1) AS DECIMAL(18,4))
        ELSE NULL

    ) AS total_building_heights,
    btd.dlc_key
  FROM building_keys bk
  LEFT JOIN building_base bb ON bb.building_key = bk.building_key
  LEFT JOIN building_to_dlc btd ON btd.building_key = bk.building_key
  LEFT JOIN building_floors bf ON bf.building_key = bk.building_key
  LEFT JOIN building_org_counts boc ON boc.building_key = bk.building_key AND boc.dlc_key = btd.dlc_key

rows.question: What is the author, school name, material status, total record counts, and total number of types of courses for each author and school?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
tm_raw AS (
  SELECT
    `TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
    `ISBN`,
    `TITLE`,
    `AUTHOR`,
    -- keep AUTHOR exactly as stored (but trim surrounding whitespace)
    NULLIF(TRIM(`AUTHOR`), '') AS author_clean
  FROM `tip_material`
),
-- We will NOT split semicolon-separated authors. Use author_clean as the AUTHOR value.
-- Join tip_material to library_reserve_catalog by ISBN (left join to keep all tip_material rows)
tm_catalog AS (
  SELECT
    tr.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
    tr.`ISBN`,
    tr.`author_clean` AS AUTHOR,
    lc.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`,
    lc.`CATALOG_ISBN`,
    lc.`CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER`
  FROM tm_raw tr
  LEFT JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` lc
    ON lc.`CATALOG_ISBN` = tr.`ISBN`
),
-- Determine MATERIAL_STATUS: prefer library_material_status joined by LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER if that maps,
-- otherwise fallback to tip_material_status joined by TIP_MATERIAL_KEY.
tm_with_status AS (
  SELECT
    tc.*,
    COALESCE(lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS`, tms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS`) AS MATERIAL_STATUS
  FROM tm_catalog tc
  LEFT JOIN `library_material_status` lms
    ON lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = tc.`CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER`
  LEFT JOIN `tip_material_status` tms
    ON tms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = tc.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
),
-- Join to tip_subject_offered to obtain OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME and COURSE_TYPE-like key.
-- There is no explicit FK; the safest approach given schema is to LEFT JOIN on SUBJECT/TERM if available.
-- We'll attempt join on SUBJECT_ID via library_reserve_matrl_detail if possible:
lrmd AS (
  SELECT
    `LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`,
    `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
    `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail`
),
-- Attempt to connect catalog -> lrmd -> tip_subject_offered by catalog key and offered key where possible.
tm_enriched AS (
  SELECT
    tws.*,
    tso.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
    tso.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`,
    -- treat COURSE_TYPE as TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY (distinct course-offering) for counting distinct course types
    tso.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` AS COURSE_TYPE_KEY
  FROM tm_with_status tws
  LEFT JOIN lrmd ON lrmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` = tws.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `tip_subject_offered` tso
    ON tso.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = lrmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
)
SELECT
  -- AUTHOR: use exactly as stored (fall back to 'UNKNOWN' for NULL/empty)
  COALESCE(AUTHOR, 'UNKNOWN') AS AUTHOR,
  -- SCHOOL_NAME: use OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME from tip_subject_offered when available; else 'UNKNOWN'
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- MATERIAL_STATUS: use as resolved above; fallback to 'UNKNOWN'
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MATERIAL_STATUS), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  -- TOTAL_RECORD_COUNT: count of rows (records) for that AUTHOR + SCHOOL_NAME + MATERIAL_STATUS
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_RECORD_COUNT,
  -- TOTAL_DISTINCT_COURSE_TYPE_COUNT: distinct count of COURSE_TYPE_KEY (TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) associated
  COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_TYPE_KEY) AS TOTAL_DISTINCT_COURSE_TYPE_COUNT
FROM tm_enriched
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(AUTHOR, 'UNKNOWN'),
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME), ''), 'UNKNOWN'),
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(MATERIAL_STATUS), ''), 'UNKNOWN')
ORDER BY
  AUTHOR,
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  MATERIAL_STATUS

WITH term_materials_aggregation AS (
  SELECT
    d.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    -- concatenate distinct material identifiers: prefer ISBN when present, else TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
    COALESCE(NULLIF(
      GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
        CASE WHEN NULLIF(d.ISBN, '') IS NOT NULL THEN d.ISBN ELSE d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY END
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN NULLIF(d.ISBN, '') IS NOT NULL THEN d.ISBN ELSE d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY END
        SEPARATOR ' | '
      ), ''
    ), '') AS materials_term_aggregation
  FROM tip_detail d
  GROUP BY d.TERM_CODE
),
tip_counts AS (
  -- count distinct TIP subjects per term (use MASTER_SUBJECT_ID from tip_subject_offered as the subject identifier)
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_tip_subjects
  FROM tip_subject_offered
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
),
subj_aggs AS (
  -- per-term aggregations from subject_offered
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students,
    MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT(DISTINCT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS distinct_schools
  FROM subject_offered
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
)
SELECT
  a.TERM_CODE                    AS term_code,
  a.TERM_DESCRIPTION             AS term_description,
  a.IS_CURRENT_TERM              AS is_current_term,
  COALESCE(t.distinct_tip_subjects, 0) AS total_distinct_tip_subjects,
  -- Materials aggregation: concatenated distinct ISBNs or material keys separated by ' | '
  COALESCE(tma.materials_term_aggregation, '') AS materials_term_aggregation,
  subj.min_enrolled_students,
  subj.max_enrolled_students,
  COALESCE(subj.distinct_schools, 0) AS total_distinct_schools,
  COALESCE(subj.total_records, 0) AS total_records
FROM academic_terms_all a
LEFT JOIN tip_counts t
  ON t.term_code = a.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN term_materials_aggregation tma
  ON tma.term_code = a.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN subj_aggs subj
  ON subj.term_code = a.TERM_CODE
ORDER BY a.TERM_CODE ASC

rows.question: List all buildings with their names, building numbers, building height, street address, city, state, HR department name, assignable square footage, total and average square footage, ordered in descending order of assignable, total, and average square footage.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT 
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, fbu.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NUMBER, fbu.BUILDING_NUMBER, fb.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  COALESCE(fbu.BUILDING_HEIGHT, fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS BUILDING_HEIGHT,
  addr.STREET_ADDRESS AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  addr.CITY AS CITY,
  addr.STATE AS STATE,
  fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fbu.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  COALESCE(fr.AREA_SUM, rm.AREA_SUM, b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fbu.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS TOTAL_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(fr.ROOM_COUNT, rm.ROOM_COUNT) > 0 THEN COALESCE(fr.AREA_SUM, rm.AREA_SUM, b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fbu.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA) / COALESCE(fr.ROOM_COUNT, rm.ROOM_COUNT)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS AVERAGE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
FROM buildings b
LEFT JOIN fclt_building fbu ON fbu.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN STREET_NAME END) AS STREET_NAME,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN STREET_NUMBER END) AS STREET_NUMBER,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN STREET_SUFFIX END) AS STREET_SUFFIX,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN CITY END) AS CITY,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN STATE END) AS STATE,
    TRIM(CONCAT(
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN STREET_NUMBER END), ''),
      CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN STREET_NUMBER END) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN STREET_NAME END) IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN STREET_NAME END), ''),
      COALESCE(CONCAT(' ', MAX(CASE WHEN ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN STREET_SUFFIX END)), '')
    )) AS STREET_ADDRESS
  FROM fac_building_address
  WHERE ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) addr ON addr.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT, SUM(AREA) AS AREA_SUM
  FROM fac_rooms
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) rm ON rm.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: List building names, their height, street address, city, state, postal code, their gross and assignable square footage, the smallest and largest floor level and the total area of all rooms for each building key.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH addr AS (
  SELECT
    fa.BUILDING_KEY,
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      NULLIF(fa.STREET_NUMBER, ''), NULLIF(fa.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX, ''), NULLIF(fa.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''), NULLIF(fa.STREET_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fa.STREET_SUFFIX, ''), NULLIF(fa.POST_DIRECTIONAL, '')
    ) AS street_address,
    fa.CITY,
    fa.STATE,
    fa.POSTAL_CODE,
    fa.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    fa.BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY
  FROM fac_building_address fa
  WHERE fa.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
),
-- aggregate floors per building to derive min/max levels and floor area sums (if floor-level areas exist)
floor_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    ff.BUILDING_KEY,
    ff.FLOOR,
    -- numeric floor when FLOOR is an integer string, else NULL
    CASE WHEN TRIM(ff.FLOOR) REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(ff.FLOOR AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS floor_num
  FROM fac_floor ff
),
floor_level_agg AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    MIN(floor_num) AS min_floor_num,
    MAX(floor_num) AS max_floor_num,
    -- fallback lexicographic min/max when numeric not available
    MIN(CASE WHEN floor_num IS NULL THEN FLOOR END) AS min_floor_lex,
    MAX(CASE WHEN floor_num IS NULL THEN FLOOR END) AS max_floor_lex
  FROM floor_bounds
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
),
-- total room area by building (use fac_rooms which has AREA)
room_area_agg AS (
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(COALESCE(r.AREA,0)) AS total_room_area
  FROM fac_rooms r
  GROUP BY r.BUILDING_KEY
),
-- prefer building-level gross/assignable from fclt_building, else sum floor areas if building-level values missing
floor_area_sum AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(COALESCE(EXT_GROSS_AREA,0)) AS sum_floor_ext_gross,
    SUM(COALESCE(ASSIGNABLE_AREA,0)) AS sum_floor_assignable
  FROM fac_floor
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height,
  -- pick one street address row per building (addresses table may have multiple; take the most recent by WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE if present)
  a.street_address,
  a.CITY AS city,
  a.STATE AS state,
  a.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
  -- gross and assignable: prefer fclt_building columns, else use summed floor areas
  COALESCE(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fas.sum_floor_ext_gross, NULL) AS gross_square_footage,
  COALESCE(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fas.sum_floor_assignable, NULL) AS assignable_square_footage,
  -- smallest floor: prefer numeric min, else lexicographic; cast numeric back to string for consistent type
  COALESCE(CAST(fla.min_floor_num AS CHAR), fla.min_floor_lex) AS smallest_floor,
  COALESCE(CAST(fla.max_floor_num AS CHAR), fla.max_floor_lex) AS largest_floor,
  COALESCE(rag.total_room_area, 0) AS total_room_area
FROM fclt_building b
-- join to a single address row per building: choose the most recent WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE if multiple addresses exist
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT t.BUILDING_KEY, t.street_address, t.CITY, t.STATE, t.POSTAL_CODE
  FROM (
    SELECT
      BUILDING_KEY, street_address, CITY, STATE, POSTAL_CODE,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE DESC, BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY DESC) AS rn
    FROM addr
  ) t
  WHERE t.rn = 1
) a ON a.BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN floor_level_agg fla
  ON fla.BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN room_area_agg rag
  ON rag.BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN floor_area_sum fas
  ON fas.BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: For building 36, list all space units, their floor and building name, building street address, their space usage, and the number of organizations and space units on the same building and floor.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY AS SPACE_ID,
  su.SPACE_UNIT AS SPACE_NAME,
  ff.FLOOR,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  -- concatenate street address parts for ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'; may produce empty string if none
  CONCAT(
    COALESCE(fba.STREET_NUMBER,''),
    CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND (fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL OR fba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL) THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,''),
    CASE WHEN fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(fba.STREET_NAME,''),
    CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(fba.STREET_SUFFIX,'')
  ) AS ADDRESS,
  sug.SPACE_USAGE,
  IFNULL(org_counts.org_count,0) AS num_organizations_on_same_building_and_floor,
  IFNULL(su_counts.space_unit_count,0) AS num_space_units_on_same_building_and_floor
FROM space_unit2 su
JOIN space_detail sd
  ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
JOIN fac_floor ff
  ON ff.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN fac_building b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
-- building street address rows (may be multiple; this will repeat space rows if multiple addresses exist per building;
-- requirement said "use the ADDRESS value(s)" so keeping join rather than aggregation)
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address fba
  ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN space_usage sug
  ON sug.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- count distinct organizations per building + floor from fac_rooms
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    fr.FLOOR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR
) org_counts
  ON org_counts.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
  AND org_counts.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR
LEFT JOIN (
  -- count distinct space units per building + floor from space_detail
  SELECT
    sd2.BUILDING_KEY,
    ff2.FLOOR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count
  FROM space_detail sd2
  JOIN fac_floor ff2 ON ff2.FLOOR_KEY = sd2.FLOOR_KEY
  WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sd2.BUILDING_KEY, ff2.FLOOR
) su_counts
  ON su_counts.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
  AND su_counts.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR
WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '36'

  UNION

    lso.TERM_CODE
  FROM library_subject_offered lso

  UNION

    tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS faculty_name,

    tso.TERM_CODE
  FROM tip_subject_offered tso
  WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2023FA' AND tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL

-- all members of MOIRA lists (keep key columns)
moira_members AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS member_identifier,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME,

  FROM moira_list_detail mld

lists_with_10_members AS (

    mm.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(mm.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,''), mm.member_identifier, mm.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME)) AS member_count
  FROM moira_members mm
  GROUP BY mm.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, mm.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

  SELECT DISTINCT
    frc.faculty_name,
    l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mm.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,
    mm.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
  FROM faculty_responsible_courses frc
  JOIN moira_members mm
    ON (TRIM(frc.faculty_name) = TRIM(mm.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME))
       OR (mm.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND mm.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID <> ''
           AND mm.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = (
             -- attempt to extract MIT id from faculty_name if given in form "Name (MITID)" or similar;

SELECT

FROM lists_with_10_members l

LEFT JOIN faculty_in_lists fil ON fil.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY

GROUP BY l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, lfc.faculty_count
ORDER BY l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: For each course instructor in the 'keeper-zephyr' mailing list, provide the name of mailing lists they subscribe to, instructor name, earliest and latest publication years, and total number of enrolled students.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH keeper_members AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS MEMBER_NAME,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM moira_list ml
  JOIN moira_list_detail mld
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'keeper-zephyr'
),
instructors AS (
  SELECT
    lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    lci.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM library_course_instructor lci
),
-- try to attach MIT_ID to instructors by exact full-name match in opa_person_current or se_person
instructor_mit AS (
  SELECT
    i.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    i.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    COALESCE(opc.MIT_ID, sp.MIT_ID) AS MIT_ID
  FROM instructors i
  LEFT JOIN opa_person_current opc
    ON opc.FULL_NAME = i.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
  LEFT JOIN se_person sp
    ON opc.MIT_ID IS NULL AND sp.FULL_NAME = i.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
),
courses AS (
  SELECT
    lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lso.TERM_CODE,
    lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrm
  JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
),
-- aggregate per instructor (by course-instructor key)
instructor_course_agg AS (
  SELECT
    im.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    im.MIT_ID,
    im.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    -- extract year token from TERM_CODE if formatted like xxxx-YYYY or similar; try numeric suffix
    MIN(CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(c.TERM_CODE, '[0-9]{4}$'), '') AS UNSIGNED)) AS earliest_publication_year,
    MAX(CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(c.TERM_CODE, '[0-9]{4}$'), '') AS UNSIGNED)) AS latest_publication_year,
    SUM(COALESCE(c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM instructor_mit im
  LEFT JOIN courses c
    ON im.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = c.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  GROUP BY im.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, im.MIT_ID, im.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
)
SELECT
  -- keep the literal mailing list name for included rows
  'keeper-zephyr' AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  -- instructor name from the course/instructor data (may be NULL if no matching instructor record)
  COALESCE(ica.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, km.MEMBER_NAME) AS instructor_name,
  -- earliest/latest publication years may be NULL if no course TERM_CODE matched
  ica.earliest_publication_year,
  ica.latest_publication_year,
  -- total enrolled students should be 0 if none
  COALESCE(ica.total_enrolled_students, 0) AS total_enrolled_students,
  -- the member's MIT_ID (if present) and member name for traceability
  km.MIT_ID AS member_mit_id,
  km.MEMBER_NAME AS member_list_member_name,
  -- list of mailing lists this member subscribes to (grouped)
  (
    SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ml2.MOIRA_LIST_NAME ORDER BY ml2.MOIRA_LIST_NAME SEPARATOR ', ')
    FROM moira_list_detail mld2
    JOIN moira_list ml2 ON mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    WHERE (mld2.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = km.MIT_ID AND km.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL)
       OR (mld2.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = km.MEMBER_NAME)
  ) AS subscribed_mailing_lists
FROM keeper_members km
LEFT JOIN instructor_course_agg ica
  -- prefer matching by MIT_ID when available, otherwise match by exact instructor name = member name
  ON (ica.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND km.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND ica.MIT_ID = km.MIT_ID)
     OR (ica.MIT_ID IS NULL AND ica.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = km.MEMBER_NAME)
-- Only include members who are instructors (i.e., have a matching instructor record) OR include them even if they have no courses/publications.
-- The intent requires rows "for every instructor who is listed as a course instructor and who subscribes..." so restrict to rows with an instructor match.
WHERE (ica.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY COALESCE(km.MIT_ID, km.MEMBER_NAME), ica.INSTRUCTOR_NAME

rows.question: Group biology courses by cluster type and course level. For each group, list the name of the department, the course title, cluster type, total enrollments, average enrollment within its cluster, course level, number of unique course materials, average new and used prices for TIP materials, total material record count for TIP materials, number of unique library titles, and number of unique library ISBNs.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH bio_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    COALESCE(so.CLUSTER_TYPE, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS CLUSTER_TYPE,
    -- derive course level from COURSE_NUMBER (fallback to MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER), map leading digit to century
    CASE
      WHEN so.COURSE_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN
        CASE LEFT(so.COURSE_NUMBER,1)
          WHEN '1' THEN '100'
          WHEN '2' THEN '200'
          WHEN '3' THEN '300'
          WHEN '4' THEN '400'
          WHEN '5' THEN '500'
          WHEN '6' THEN '600'
          ELSE 'OTHER'
        END
      WHEN so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN
        CASE LEFT(so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,1)
          WHEN '1' THEN '100'
          WHEN '2' THEN '200'
          WHEN '3' THEN '300'
          WHEN '4' THEN '400'
          WHEN '5' THEN '500'
          WHEN '6' THEN '600'
          ELSE 'OTHER'
        END
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS COURSE_LEVEL,
    COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    so.SUBJECT_KEY,
    so.SECTION_ID
  FROM subject_offered so
  WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'
),
cluster_aggregates AS (
  -- compute average enrollment per (cluster_type, course_level) among Biology courses
  SELECT
    CLUSTER_TYPE,
    COURSE_LEVEL,
    AVG(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0)) AS AVG_ENROLLMENT_WITHIN_CLUSTER_TYPE
  FROM bio_subjects
  GROUP BY CLUSTER_TYPE, COURSE_LEVEL
),
tip_per_course AS (
  -- TIP metrics (only TIP materials from tip_detail / tip_material)
  SELECT
    td.TERM_CODE,
    td.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS NUM_UNIQUE_COURSE_MATERIALS_FOR_COURSE,
    AVG(NULLIF(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE,0)) AS AVG_TIP_NEW_PRICE_FOR_COURSE,
    AVG(NULLIF(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE,0)) AS AVG_TIP_USED_PRICE_FOR_COURSE,
    SUM(COALESCE(td.RECORD_COUNT,0)) AS TOTAL_TIP_MATERIAL_RECORD_COUNT_FOR_COURSE
  FROM tip_detail td
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  WHERE td.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID
),
library_per_course AS (
  -- library metrics deduplicated by reserve catalog key and ISBN
  SELECT
    lrod.TERM_CODE,
    lrod.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrod.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS NUM_UNIQUE_LIBRARY_TITLES_FOR_COURSE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN,'')) AS NUM_UNIQUE_LIBRARY_ISBNS_FOR_COURSE
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrod
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    ON lrod.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  WHERE lrod.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY lrod.TERM_CODE, lrod.SUBJECT_ID
)
SELECT
  bs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, -- will be 'Biology' per filter
  bs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS COURSE_TITLE,
  bs.CLUSTER_TYPE AS CLUSTER_TYPE,
  COALESCE(bs.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT_FOR_COURSE,
  ca.AVG_ENROLLMENT_WITHIN_CLUSTER_TYPE,
  bs.COURSE_LEVEL AS COURSE_LEVEL,
  COALESCE(tp.NUM_UNIQUE_COURSE_MATERIALS_FOR_COURSE,0) AS NUM_UNIQUE_COURSE_MATERIALS_FOR_COURSE,
  ROUND(COALESCE(tp.AVG_TIP_NEW_PRICE_FOR_COURSE,0),2) AS AVG_TIP_NEW_PRICE_FOR_COURSE,
  ROUND(COALESCE(tp.AVG_TIP_USED_PRICE_FOR_COURSE,0),2) AS AVG_TIP_USED_PRICE_FOR_COURSE,
  COALESCE(tp.TOTAL_TIP_MATERIAL_RECORD_COUNT_FOR_COURSE,0) AS TOTAL_TIP_MATERIAL_RECORD_COUNT_FOR_COURSE,
  COALESCE(lp.NUM_UNIQUE_LIBRARY_TITLES_FOR_COURSE,0) AS NUM_UNIQUE_LIBRARY_TITLES_FOR_COURSE,
  COALESCE(lp.NUM_UNIQUE_LIBRARY_ISBNS_FOR_COURSE,0) AS NUM_UNIQUE_LIBRARY_ISBNS_FOR_COURSE
FROM bio_subjects bs
LEFT JOIN cluster_aggregates ca
  ON bs.CLUSTER_TYPE = ca.CLUSTER_TYPE
  AND bs.COURSE_LEVEL = ca.COURSE_LEVEL
LEFT JOIN tip_per_course tp
  ON bs.TERM_CODE = tp.TERM_CODE
  AND bs.SUBJECT_ID = tp.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN library_per_course lp
  ON bs.TERM_CODE = lp.TERM_CODE
  AND bs.SUBJECT_ID = lp.SUBJECT_ID
ORDER BY bs.CLUSTER_TYPE, bs.COURSE_LEVEL, bs.SUBJECT_ID

WITH course_rooms AS (
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    so.COURSE_NUMBER,
    so.SECTION_ID,
    so.MEET_PLACE,
    so.MEET_TIME,
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    -- try to get a room number from fac_rooms: prefer ROOM, then SPACE_ID, then ROOM_FULL_NAME
    fr.ROOM AS ROOM_NUMBER,

    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,

  -- only include rows with non-NULL meet place and meet time per requirements
  JOIN fac_rooms fr
    ON (so.MEET_PLACE = fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME
        OR so.MEET_PLACE = fr.SPACE_ID
        OR so.MEET_PLACE = fr.ROOM)
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_organization fo
    ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary ss
    ON so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
  WHERE so.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
    AND so.MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL
),

    cr.BUILDING_NUMBER,

    cr.BUILDING_STATE,

    cr.COURSE_NUMBER,
    cr.TERM_CODE,
    cr.ROOM_NUMBER,

        AND lc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE IS NOT NULL

    m.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,

    m.SUBJECT_ID,

  FROM joined j

  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso

  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
    ON so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` = sd.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`

WITH normalized_terms AS (
  SELECT
    -- stable row id
    COALESCE(academic_terms_all.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, academic_terms_all.TERM_CODE) AS row_id,

    -- keep financial_aid_year and academic_year as-is but normalize empty strings to NULL
    NULLIF(TRIM(academic_terms_all.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR), '') AS financial_aid_year,
    NULLIF(TRIM(academic_terms_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR), '') AS academic_year,

    -- classify fiscal-period indicator: treat presence of FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR as fiscal period;
    -- also treat TERM_SELECTOR that contains 'fy' as fiscal indicator
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(academic_terms_all.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 1
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(academic_terms_all.TERM_SELECTOR), '') IS NOT NULL
           AND LOWER(TRIM(academic_terms_all.TERM_SELECTOR)) LIKE '%fy%' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_fiscal_period,

    -- classify quarter indicator based on TERM_DESCRIPTION, TERM_SELECTOR, or TERM_CODE patterns
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(academic_terms_all.TERM_DESCRIPTION), '') IS NOT NULL
           AND (LOWER(academic_terms_all.TERM_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%quarter%' OR LOWER(academic_terms_all.TERM_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '% q%') THEN 1
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(academic_terms_all.TERM_SELECTOR), '') IS NOT NULL
           AND (LOWER(academic_terms_all.TERM_SELECTOR) LIKE '%quarter%' OR LOWER(academic_terms_all.TERM_SELECTOR) LIKE '% q%') THEN 1
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(academic_terms_all.TERM_CODE), '') IS NOT NULL
           AND (academic_terms_all.TERM_CODE REGEXP 'Q[1-4]|q[1-4]|[0-9]{4}Q[1-4]') THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_quarter,

    -- parse start and end dates; try common formats then CAST
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(academic_terms_all.TERM_START_DATE), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE COALESCE(
        CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(academic_terms_all.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') IS NOT NULL
             THEN DATE(STR_TO_DATE(academic_terms_all.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')) ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(academic_terms_all.TERM_START_DATE, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NOT NULL
             THEN DATE(STR_TO_DATE(academic_terms_all.TERM_START_DATE, '%m/%d/%Y')) ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(academic_terms_all.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y%m%d') IS NOT NULL
             THEN DATE(STR_TO_DATE(academic_terms_all.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y%m%d')) ELSE NULL END,
        CAST(academic_terms_all.TERM_START_DATE AS DATE)
      )
    END AS term_start_date,

    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(academic_terms_all.TERM_END_DATE), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE COALESCE(
        CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(academic_terms_all.TERM_END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') IS NOT NULL
             THEN DATE(STR_TO_DATE(academic_terms_all.TERM_END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')) ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(academic_terms_all.TERM_END_DATE, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NOT NULL
             THEN DATE(STR_TO_DATE(academic_terms_all.TERM_END_DATE, '%m/%d/%Y')) ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(academic_terms_all.TERM_END_DATE, '%Y%m%d') IS NOT NULL
             THEN DATE(STR_TO_DATE(academic_terms_all.TERM_END_DATE, '%Y%m%d')) ELSE NULL END,
        CAST(academic_terms_all.TERM_END_DATE AS DATE)
      )
    END AS term_end_date,

    -- department-level term parameter: use TERM_SELECTOR (as instructed), normalized to NULL if empty
    NULLIF(TRIM(academic_terms_all.TERM_SELECTOR), '') AS department_term_parameter

  FROM academic_terms_all
)
SELECT
  financial_aid_year,
  academic_year,
  -- count rows marked as fiscal periods in the group
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_fiscal_period = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fiscal_periods,
  -- count rows marked as quarters in the group
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_quarter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_quarters,
  -- earliest start date and latest end date per group
  MIN(term_start_date) AS start_term_date,
  MAX(term_end_date) AS end_term_date,
  -- distinct non-null department-level term parameters per group
  COUNT(DISTINCT department_term_parameter) AS distinct_department_term_parameters
FROM normalized_terms
GROUP BY
  financial_aid_year,
  academic_year
ORDER BY
  financial_aid_year ASC,
  academic_year ASC

rows.question: Group buildings by campus sectors. For each group, list the campus sector, name of the building, city and state where the building is located, total number of floors, total assignable area, total number of rooms, total number of organizations, ownership type, and a rank column indicating the order (1-indexed) of this row within each sector based on the descending order of assignable area. Include subtotals for each sector and a grand total across all sectors. The subtotal and grand total only need to computed over the total number of floors and assignable area.

WITH
-- per-building aggregates: floors, rooms, organizations, choose address, assignable area from buildings then fac_building
building_aggs AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY                          AS building_key,
    fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR                              AS campus_sector,
    COALESCE(bd.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME)  AS building_name,
    fba.CITY                                      AS city,
    fba.STATE                                     AS state,
    COALESCE(ff.total_number_of_floors, 0)        AS total_number_of_floors,
    COALESCE(bd.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) AS total_assignable_area,
    COALESCE(fr.total_number_of_rooms, 0)         AS total_number_of_rooms,
    COALESCE(fr.total_number_of_organizations, 0) AS total_number_of_organizations,
    fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE                             AS ownership_type
  FROM fac_building fb
  LEFT JOIN buildings bd
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = bd.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR_KEY) AS total_number_of_floors
    FROM fac_floor
    WHERE FLOOR_KEY IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
  ) ff
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = ff.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT BUILDING_KEY,
           COUNT(*) AS total_number_of_rooms,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_number_of_organizations
    FROM fac_rooms
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
  ) fr
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
),
-- rank buildings within each campus_sector by descending assignable area (dense rank)
ranked_buildings AS (
  SELECT
    ba.*,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ba.campus_sector ORDER BY ba.total_assignable_area DESC) AS rnk
  FROM building_aggs ba
),
-- sector subtotals: sum floors and assignable area per campus sector
sector_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    campus_sector,
    SUM(total_number_of_floors)       AS subtotal_total_floors,
    SUM(total_assignable_area)        AS subtotal_total_assignable_area
  FROM ranked_buildings
  GROUP BY campus_sector
),
-- grand totals across all sectors (sum only floors and assignable area)
grand_totals AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS campus_sector,
    SUM(total_number_of_floors)    AS grand_total_floors,
    SUM(total_assignable_area)     AS grand_total_assignable_area
  FROM ranked_buildings
)

-- final unioned result: building rows, then per-sector subtotal row, then grand total row
SELECT
  campus_sector,
  building_name,
  city,
  state,
  total_number_of_floors,
  total_assignable_area,
  total_number_of_rooms,
  total_number_of_organizations,
  ownership_type,
  rnk
FROM ranked_buildings

UNION ALL

SELECT
  ss.campus_sector AS campus_sector,
  NULL AS building_name,
  NULL AS city,
  NULL AS state,
  ss.subtotal_total_floors AS total_number_of_floors,
  ss.subtotal_total_assignable_area AS total_assignable_area,
  NULL AS total_number_of_rooms,
  NULL AS total_number_of_organizations,
  NULL AS ownership_type,
  NULL AS rnk
FROM sector_subtotals ss

UNION ALL

SELECT
  gt.campus_sector AS campus_sector,
  NULL AS building_name,
  NULL AS city,
  NULL AS state,
  gt.grand_total_floors AS total_number_of_floors,
  gt.grand_total_assignable_area AS total_assignable_area,
  NULL AS total_number_of_rooms,
  NULL AS total_number_of_organizations,
  NULL AS ownership_type,
  NULL AS rnk
FROM grand_totals gt

-- ordering: by campus sector (alphabetical, NULLs last), within sector building rows by rank (ascending = largest first),
-- then subtotal row (which has NULL rank) after building rows, and grand total last (campus_sector = 'Grand Total')
ORDER BY
  -- ensure grand total appears last by treating its label after normal sectors
  CASE WHEN campus_sector = 'Grand Total' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END,
  (campus_sector IS NULL),       -- NULL sectors after non-null sectors
  campus_sector,
  -- place building rows (rnk not null) before subtotal (rnk null) and order buildings by rank (1 = largest)
  CASE WHEN rnk IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  rnk,
  -- tie-breaker: larger assignable area first (for rows that share same rank value due to dense_rank ties)
  total_assignable_area DESC

rows.question: For each building use, list the type, the number of distinct buildings (excluding subdivisions) of this use, the total gross square footage of these buildings, and the number of unique organizations associated with the rooms in these buildings. If the building is used as a residence, display the usage type as "RESIDENTIAL." You should also include a row at the end showing the total number of buildings, the gross square footage, and the number of organizations across all types of building use. All numerical values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_rows AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_KEY, fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_id,
    -- prefer BUILDING_USE from fclt_building (alias f) then fac_building (fb) then buildings (b) if present
    COALESCE(NULLIF(f.BUILDING_USE,''), NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_USE,''), NULLIF(b.BUILDING_NAME,'')) AS building_use,
    -- gross square footage preference: fclt_building EXT_GROSS_AREA, then buildings BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, then fac_building EXT_GROSS_AREA
    COALESCE(f.EXT_GROSS_AREA, b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, 0) AS gross_sqft,
    -- subdivision determination: presence of a parent building number on facility tables or multiple rows with same building number in canonical buildings
    CASE
      WHEN (f.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(f.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER) <> '')
        OR (fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER) <> '')
        OR (
            b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(b.BUILDING_NUMBER) <> ''
            AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM buildings bb
              WHERE bb.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
                AND bb.BUILDING_KEY <> b.BUILDING_KEY
            )
          )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_subdivision
  FROM fclt_building f
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = f.BUILDING_NUMBER
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
per_use AS (
  -- aggregate per building use (excluding subdivisions)
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN building_use = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL' ELSE building_use END AS building_use_label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT building_id) AS building_count,
    SUM(ROUND(IFNULL(gross_sqft,0))) AS total_gross_sqft,
    -- count distinct organizations from rooms linked to the buildings of this use
    -- join to fclt_rooms by building key
    0 AS org_count_placeholder
  FROM building_rows
  WHERE is_subdivision = 0
  GROUP BY building_use_label
),
org_counts AS (
  -- compute distinct organization counts per building use by joining rooms to building_rows (non-subdivisions)
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN br.building_use = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL' ELSE br.building_use END AS building_use_label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count
  FROM building_rows br
  LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fr
    ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = br.building_id
  WHERE br.is_subdivision = 0
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN br.building_use = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL' ELSE br.building_use END
),
per_use_with_org AS (
  SELECT
    p.building_use_label,
    p.building_count,
    p.total_gross_sqft,
    COALESCE(o.org_count, 0) AS org_count
  FROM per_use p
  LEFT JOIN org_counts o
    USING (building_use_label)
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    'Total' AS building_use_label,
    SUM(building_count) AS building_count,
    SUM(total_gross_sqft) AS total_gross_sqft,
    SUM(org_count) AS org_count
  FROM per_use_with_org
)
SELECT
  building_use_label AS building_use,
  FORMAT(ROUND(building_count),0) AS building_count,
  FORMAT(ROUND(total_gross_sqft),0) AS total_gross_sqft,
  FORMAT(ROUND(org_count),0) AS organization_count
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM per_use_with_org
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM totals
) t
ORDER BY
  -- ensure 'Total' comes last; alphabetical otherwise
  CASE WHEN building_use = 'Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  building_use

rows.question: List each building key and floor key within the department of facilities, the number of rooms, total area, average area per floor, building name, access level, zip code, and city. WITH detail_rows AS (
  -- detail rows: each building + floor within DP OF FACILITIES
  SELECT
    fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY AS floor_key,
    COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS rooms_count,
    SUM(IFNULL(fr.AREA,0)) AS total_area,
    -- average area per floor: prefer the floor's ASSIGNABLE_AREA when available, else use SUM(area)
    COALESCE(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, SUM(IFNULL(fr.AREA,0))) AS avg_area_per_floor,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME AS access_level,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
    fba.CITY AS city
  FROM fclt_rooms fr
  JOIN fclt_floor ff
    ON fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
    AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb
    ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
    -- prefer mailing/primary if present; allow NULL to join as well
    AND (fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE IS NULL OR fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE IN ('MAILING','PRIMARY'))
  WHERE fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'DP OF FACILITIES'
  GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fba.CITY

    -- average area per floor for building: average of the floor-level avg_area_per_floor weighted by floor count (i.e. simple avg of floor values)
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(avg_area_per_floor)/COUNT(*) END AS avg_area_per_floor,
    MAX(building_name) AS building_name,

  FROM detail_rows
  GROUP BY building_key

  SELECT
    NULL AS building_key,
    NULL AS floor_key,
    SUM(rooms_count) AS rooms_count,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(avg_area_per_floor)/COUNT(*) END AS avg_area_per_floor
  FROM detail_rows
)

WITH courses AS (
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    so.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,

    so.MEET_PLACE AS MEET_PLACE
  FROM subject_offered so
),
-- try to parse MEET_TIME into start and end dates. Common delimiters: 'to', '-', '–' etc.
parsed_dates AS (
  SELECT
    c.*,
    -- get candidate start/end tokens based on ' to ' (with spaces) first, else 'to' no-spaces, else ' - ' , else '–', else treat whole as single date
    TRIM(
      CASE
        WHEN INSTR(c.MEET_TIME, ' to ') > 0 THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_TIME, ' to ', 1)
        WHEN INSTR(c.MEET_TIME, 'to') > 0 THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_TIME, 'to', 1)
        WHEN INSTR(c.MEET_TIME, ' - ') > 0 THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_TIME, ' - ', 1)
        WHEN INSTR(c.MEET_TIME, '–') > 0 THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_TIME, '–', 1)
        ELSE c.MEET_TIME
      END
    ) AS MEET_START_RAW,
    TRIM(
      CASE
        WHEN INSTR(c.MEET_TIME, ' to ') > 0 THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_TIME, ' to ', -1)
        WHEN INSTR(c.MEET_TIME, 'to') > 0 THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_TIME, 'to', -1)
        WHEN INSTR(c.MEET_TIME, ' - ') > 0 THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_TIME, ' - ', -1)
        WHEN INSTR(c.MEET_TIME, '–') > 0 THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_TIME, '–', -1)
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS MEET_END_RAW
  FROM courses c
),
parsed_formats AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    -- try common date formats: ISO yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy/mm/dd, mm/dd/yyyy, m/d/yyyy, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' (take date part), etc.
    -- parse start
    COALESCE(
      STR_TO_DATE(MEET_START_RAW, '%Y-%m-%d'),
      STR_TO_DATE(MEET_START_RAW, '%Y/%m/%d'),
      STR_TO_DATE(MEET_START_RAW, '%m/%d/%Y'),
      STR_TO_DATE(MEET_START_RAW, '%c/%e/%Y'),
      -- sometimes datetime with time; try extracting date portion then parse
      STR_TO_DATE(LEFT(MEET_START_RAW, 10), '%Y-%m-%d'),
      STR_TO_DATE(LEFT(MEET_START_RAW, 10), '%m/%d/%Y')
    ) AS START_DATE,
    -- parse end
    COALESCE(
      STR_TO_DATE(MEET_END_RAW, '%Y-%m-%d'),
      STR_TO_DATE(MEET_END_RAW, '%Y/%m/%d'),
      STR_TO_DATE(MEET_END_RAW, '%m/%d/%Y'),
      STR_TO_DATE(MEET_END_RAW, '%c/%e/%Y'),
      STR_TO_DATE(LEFT(MEET_END_RAW, 10), '%Y-%m-%d'),
      STR_TO_DATE(LEFT(MEET_END_RAW, 10), '%m/%d/%Y')
    ) AS END_DATE
  FROM parsed_dates p
),
durations AS (
  SELECT
    pf.SUBJECT_ID,
    pf.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    pf.TERM_CODE,
    pf.MEET_PLACE,
    pf.START_DATE,
    pf.END_DATE,
    -- duration in days:
    -- if START_DATE is null -> NULL (can't compute)
    -- if END_DATE is null -> treat as 1 day
    -- else DATEDIFF(END_DATE, START_DATE) + 1 to include both endpoints
    CASE
      WHEN pf.START_DATE IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN pf.END_DATE IS NULL THEN 1
      WHEN pf.END_DATE < pf.START_DATE THEN 1
      ELSE DATEDIFF(pf.END_DATE, pf.START_DATE) + 1
    END AS DURATION_DAYS
  FROM parsed_formats pf
),
room_building AS (
  SELECT
    d.*,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_KEY
  FROM durations d
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON (b.BUILDING_NAME = d.MEET_PLACE OR b.BUILDING_NUMBER = d.MEET_PLACE)

-- TERM_CODE used as available academic term/year identifier). Keep key columns for joinability.

  SELECT
    rb.SUBJECT_ID,
    rb.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    rb.TERM_CODE AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,

    rb.END_DATE,
    rb.DURATION_DAYS
  FROM room_building rb

  ROUND(

      PARTITION BY f.ACADEMIC_YEAR
      ORDER BY f.START_DATE
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ),
    2
  ) AS running_avg_duration_days
FROM final f
ORDER BY f.ACADEMIC_YEAR, f.START_DATE, f.SUBJECT_ID

    0 AS floor_room_count
  FROM `fclt_floor`
  WHERE `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
),
-- Sum areas per building from floors (only buildings that have one or more floors will appear here)
building_floor_sums AS (
  SELECT
    fa.`BUILDING_KEY`,
    SUM(fa.floor_assignable_area) AS total_assignable_area,
    SUM(fa.floor_non_assignable_area) AS total_non_assignable_area
  FROM floor_areas fa
  GROUP BY fa.`BUILDING_KEY`
),
-- Count rooms per building; treat NULL building keys as excluded
room_counts AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    SUM(COALESCE(`ROOM_COUNTER`, 1)) AS total_room_count_by_rooms_table -- fallback if ROOM_COUNTER absent per row
  FROM (
    SELECT BUILDING_KEY, COALESCE(`ROOM_COUNTER`, 1) AS `ROOM_COUNTER`
    FROM `space_detail`
    WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT BUILDING_KEY, 1 AS `ROOM_COUNTER`
    FROM `fac_rooms`
    WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY, 1 AS `ROOM_COUNTER`
    FROM `fclt_rooms`
    WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  ) r
  GROUP BY `BUILDING_KEY`
),
-- Building basic info
building_info AS (
  SELECT
    b.`BUILDING_KEY`,
    b.`BUILDING_NAME`,
    b.`BUILDING_NUMBER`
  FROM `buildings` b
)
-- Final: include every building that has one or more floors (inner join to building_floor_sums)
SELECT
  bi.`BUILDING_NAME` AS building_name,
  bi.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS building_number,
  COALESCE(bfs.total_assignable_area, 0) AS total_assignable_area,
  COALESCE(bfs.total_non_assignable_area, 0) AS total_non_assignable_area,
  COALESCE(rc.total_room_count_by_rooms_table, 0) AS total_room_count
FROM building_floor_sums bfs
JOIN building_info bi
  ON bfs.`BUILDING_KEY` = bi.`BUILDING_KEY`
LEFT JOIN room_counts rc
  ON bi.`BUILDING_KEY` = rc.`BUILDING_KEY`
ORDER BY total_assignable_area DESC

rows.question: List the name, number, construction date, and type of all buildings, along with the count of addresses associated with each building, the average gross area of the buildings, and the total number of rooms in each building. Sort the results by building name.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  COALESCE(fb.DATE_BUILT, fbh.DATE_BUILT, fac.DATE_BUILT) AS date_built,
  COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fbh.BUILDING_TYPE, fac.BUILDING_TYPE) AS building_type,
  COALESCE(addr.addr_count, 0) AS address_count,
  AVG(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER () AS avg_gross_area,
  COALESCE(r.rooms_total, 0) AS total_rooms
FROM buildings b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, DATE_BUILT, BUILDING_TYPE
  FROM fclt_building
) fb
  ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_hist fbh
  ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY OR fbh.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN fac_building fac
  ON fac.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY OR fac.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(*) AS addr_count
  FROM fac_building_address
  WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) addr
  ON addr.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, SUM(BLDG_ROOM_COUNT) AS rooms_total
  FROM (
    SELECT BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(*) AS BLDG_ROOM_COUNT
    FROM fac_rooms
    WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
    UNION ALL
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(*) AS BLDG_ROOM_COUNT
    FROM fclt_rooms
    WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  ) t
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NAME

rows.question: For each department, list its name, number of unique courses offered, the number of unique reserved materials, and the number of unique instructors associated with those courses, sorted by the number of unique courses offered in descending order.

WITH dept_courses AS (
  -- courses offered by each department
  SELECT
    so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    so.`SUBJECT_ID`
  FROM `subject_offered` so
  WHERE so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`, so.`SUBJECT_ID`
),
dept_reserved_materials AS (
  -- reserved materials tied to subject_offered (by SUBJECT_ID and TERM_CODE if present)
  SELECT
    so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    lrd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrd
  JOIN `subject_offered` so
    ON lrd.`SUBJECT_ID` = so.`SUBJECT_ID`
  WHERE so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`, lrd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
),
dept_instructors AS (
  -- instructors associated with the department's courses:
  -- 1) instructors listed on subject_offered.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
  -- 2) instructors from library_course_instructor where DEPARTMENT matches the department code
  SELECT
    so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME
  FROM `subject_offered` so
  WHERE so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
    AND so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  SELECT
    lci.`DEPARTMENT` AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME
  FROM `library_course_instructor` lci
  WHERE lci.`DEPARTMENT` IS NOT NULL
    AND lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` IS NOT NULL
),
dept_instructors_distinct AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, INSTRUCTOR_NAME
  FROM dept_instructors
)
SELECT
  d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS department_name,
  COALESCE(c.course_count, 0) AS distinct_course_count,
  COALESCE(r.reserved_count, 0) AS distinct_reserved_material_count,
  COALESCE(i.instructor_count, 0) AS distinct_instructor_count
FROM `sis_department` d
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS course_count
  FROM dept_courses
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
) c ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_count
  FROM dept_reserved_materials
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
) r ON r.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS instructor_count
  FROM dept_instructors_distinct
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
) i ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY distinct_course_count DESC

rows.question: For each instructor, list their name, the number of unique courses they teach, the total number of material assignments, average publication year, and number of distinct status, sorted by the number of unique courses in descending order.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS UNIQUE_COURSES_TAUGHT,
  COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) + COUNT(lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS TOTAL_MATERIAL_ASSIGNMENTS,
  -- average publication year from tip_material.YEAR and library_reserve_catalog.CATALOG_YEAR (numeric where possible)
  (NULLIF(AVG(CAST(NULLIF(tm_num.YEAR, '') AS DECIMAL(9,2))), 0)
   + NULLIF(AVG(CAST(NULLIF(lrc_num.CATALOG_YEAR, '') AS DECIMAL(9,2))), 0)
  ) / 
  ( (CASE WHEN AVG(CAST(NULLIF(tm_num.YEAR, '') AS DECIMAL(9,2))) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    + (CASE WHEN AVG(CAST(NULLIF(lrc_num.CATALOG_YEAR, '') AS DECIMAL(9,2))) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ) AS AVG_PUBLICATION_YEAR,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY)) AS DISTINCT_STATUS_COUNT
FROM library_course_instructor lci
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
  ON lso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN tip_material_status tms
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
-- helpers to compute numeric years (prevent non-numeric causing errors)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, YEAR FROM tip_material
) tm_num ON tm_num.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, CATALOG_YEAR FROM library_reserve_catalog
) lrc_num ON lrc_num.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
GROUP BY lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
ORDER BY UNIQUE_COURSES_TAUGHT DESC

rows.question: For each sponsor, list the sponsor name, the number of IAP sessions hosted, and the number of unique subjects organized.

WITH iap_sessions_sel AS (
  SELECT
    s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS session_id,
    sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY AS sponsor_id,
    sp.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AS subject_raw,
    d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS activity_title,
    d.TERM_CODE AS term_code
  FROM iap_subject_session AS s
  JOIN iap_subject_detail AS d
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN iap_subject_sponsor AS sp
    ON sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  WHERE (
      -- match any column that may indicate IAP (case-insensitive)
      LOWER(COALESCE(s.SESSION_TITLE, '')) LIKE '%iap%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.SESSION_DESCRIPTION, '')) LIKE '%iap%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.SESSION_LOCATION, '')) LIKE '%iap%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.SESSION_DATE, '')) LIKE '%iap%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '')) LIKE '%iap%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '')) LIKE '%iap%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.HAS_SESSION_INFO, '')) LIKE '%iap%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, '')) LIKE '%iap%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, '')) LIKE '%iap%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.TERM_CODE, '')) LIKE '%iap%'
  )
  AND d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY IS NOT NULL
  AND d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY <> ''
)
SELECT
  sponsor_id,
  COALESCE(sponsor_name, sponsor_id) AS sponsor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS iap_session_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(subject_raw)) 
    - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN subject_raw IS NULL OR TRIM(subject_raw) = '' THEN LOWER(subject_raw) END) 
    AS unique_subject_count
FROM iap_sessions_sel

-- but still count sessions even if subject is NULL (require sponsor present already)
GROUP BY sponsor_id, sponsor_name

rows.question: For subjects offered in the summer term, list the subject titles, number of instructors, and the length of the longest instructor name.

SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(i.instructor), '')) AS num_instructors,
  COALESCE(MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(i.instructor))), 0) AS longest_instructor_name_length
FROM subject_offered so
JOIN (
  -- gather instructors from subject_offered.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME (single name)
  SELECT SUBJECT_KEY, TRIM(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS instructor
  FROM subject_offered
  WHERE COALESCE(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, '') <> ''

  UNION ALL

  -- gather instructors from drupal_course_catalog FALL_INSTRUCTORS and SPRING_INSTRUCTORS-like columns
  -- split comma-separated lists up to 10 entries
  SELECT so2.SUBJECT_KEY,
         TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', nums.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor
  FROM subject_offered so2
  JOIN drupal_course_catalog d ON d.SUBJECT_ID = so2.SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN (SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
        UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10) nums
    ON nums.n <= GREATEST(1,
         1 + LENGTH(COALESCE(d.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, '')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(d.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ''), ',', ''))
       )
  WHERE COALESCE(d.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, '') <> ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT so3.SUBJECT_KEY,
         TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d2.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', nums2.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor
  FROM subject_offered so3

         TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(cis.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', nums3.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor
  FROM subject_offered so4
  JOIN cis_course_catalog cis ON cis.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = so4.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN (SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
        UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10) nums3
    ON nums3.n <= GREATEST(1,
         1 + LENGTH(COALESCE(cis.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, '')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(cis.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ''), ',', ''))
       )
  WHERE COALESCE(cis.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, '') <> ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT so5.SUBJECT_KEY,
         TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(cis2.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', nums4.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor
  FROM subject_offered so5
  JOIN cis_course_catalog cis2 ON cis2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = so5.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN (SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
        UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10) nums4
    ON nums4.n <= GREATEST(1,
         1 + LENGTH(COALESCE(cis2.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, '')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(cis2.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ''), ',', ''))
       )
  WHERE COALESCE(cis2.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, '') <> ''

  UNION ALL

  -- gather from course_catalog_subject_offered via SUBJECT_ID
  SELECT so6.SUBJECT_KEY,
         TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(cc.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', nums5.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor
  FROM subject_offered so6
  JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered cc ON cc.SUBJECT_ID = so6.SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN (SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
        UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10) nums5
    ON nums5.n <= GREATEST(1,
         1 + LENGTH(COALESCE(cc.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, '')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(cc.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ''), ',', ''))
       )
  WHERE COALESCE(cc.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, '') <> ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT so7.SUBJECT_KEY,
         TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(cc2.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', nums6.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor
  FROM subject_offered so7

rows.question: For each school, list the school name, total number of courses that appear in SIS subject code catalog, and the total number of degree-granting courses that appear in SIS subject code catalog.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(d.SCHOOL_NAME, 'UNKNOWN') AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(ssc.SCHOOL_CODE, '||', ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, '||', IFNULL(ssc.COURSE_NUMBER,''))) AS TOTAL_COURSES_IN_SIS_SUBJECT_CODE_CATALOG,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
                      THEN CONCAT(ssc.SCHOOL_CODE, '||', ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, '||', IFNULL(ssc.COURSE_NUMBER,''))
                 END) AS TOTAL_DEGREE_GRANTING_COURSES_IN_SIS_SUBJECT_CODE_CATALOG
FROM sis_subject_code ssc
LEFT JOIN sis_department d
  ON ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = d.SCHOOL_CODE
LEFT JOIN sis_course_description scd
  -- join course description where its COURSE matches the subject_code from sis_subject_code
  ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE
GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(ssc.SCHOOL_CODE, '||', ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, '||', IFNULL(ssc.COURSE_NUMBER,''))) > 0

rows.question: For each department, list the department name, department phone number, number of students, and the length of the longest student full name in that department.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH dept AS (
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('-', sa.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE, sa.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER), '-') AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE
  FROM student_department sd
  LEFT JOIN sis_admin_department sa
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sa.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
students AS (
  SELECT
    md.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS STUDENT_COUNT,
    MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(md.FULL_NAME, ''))) AS MAX_STUDENT_NAME_LENGTH
  FROM mit_student_directory md
  -- include rows where department is null would not join to any dept; we only need students linked to departments
  GROUP BY md.DEPARTMENT
)
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE AS department_phone,
  COALESCE(s.STUDENT_COUNT, 0) AS student_count,
  COALESCE(s.MAX_STUDENT_NAME_LENGTH, 0) AS max_full_name_length
FROM dept d
LEFT JOIN students s
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
